_meta.note: Sample/demo dataset for a portfolio project. Visa rules, fees, and links change frequently — always confirm on the linked official government site before applying. Coverage currently includes 5 countries; extend the 'countries' array with the same shape to add more.

visa_categories.label: Tourist / Schengen Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 10-15 calendar days
required_documents: Valid passport (issued within 10 years, valid 3+ months beyond stay)
Completed Schengen visa application form
Travel health insurance covering at least €30,000
Proof of accommodation (hotel booking or invitation letter)
Bank statements showing sufficient funds for the trip
step_by_step_guideline: Confirm you need a Schengen visa and Germany is your main destination.
Book an appointment at the German consulate or an authorized visa center.
Submit your application, biometrics, and supporting documents in person.
Track your application and collect your passport once the visa is issued.

visa_categories.label: Student Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 4-12 weeks
required_documents: University admission/enrollment letter
Proof of a blocked account (Sperrkonto) or equivalent financing proof
Health insurance valid in Germany
Academic certificates and transcripts
Valid passport and biometric photos
step_by_step_guideline: Secure admission to a German university or a recognized preparatory course.
Open a blocked account and deposit the required annual living-cost amount.
Book a visa appointment and submit your documents at the German mission.
Enter Germany and register your address and residence permit locally.

visa_categories.label: Work Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 15-20 business days
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity beyond intended stay)
Completed national visa application form
Biometric passport photographs (2, taken within last 6 months)
Proof of qualification recognition (Anerkennung) or employment contract
Proof of health insurance valid in Germany
step_by_step_guideline: Book an appointment at the German consulate or embassy in your home country.
Submit the completed application form along with all required supporting documents.
Attend the biometric data collection and in-person interview at the consulate.
Track application status online and collect the visa once a decision has been issued.

visa_categories.label: PR / Citizenship
visa_categories.processing_time: 6-18 months, after required residency years are met
required_documents: Proof of continuous legal residence (typically 5-8 years, less with strong integration)
German language certificate (B1 minimum, C1 for faster naturalization)
Passed 'Leben in Deutschland' naturalization test certificate
Proof of stable income and no reliance on public welfare
Clean criminal record certificate (Führungszeugnis)
step_by_step_guideline: Confirm you meet the minimum legal residence period for your visa route.
Pass the required German language level and the naturalization test.
Submit your application with proof of income and a clean record to your local immigration office.
Attend the final interview and receive your settlement permit or naturalization certificate.

visa_categories.label: Tourist / Visitor Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: About 3 weeks
required_documents: Valid passport or travel document
Completed online Standard Visitor application
Bank statements showing sufficient funds
Proof of accommodation for your stay
Return or onward travel itinerary
step_by_step_guideline: Check whether your nationality needs a visa or an ETA to visit the UK.
Complete the Standard Visitor visa application online and pay the fee.
Book and attend a biometric appointment at a visa application centre.
Wait for the decision — most are made within about 3 weeks.

visa_categories.label: Student Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: About 3 weeks
required_documents: Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from a licensed sponsor
Valid passport
Proof of funds for tuition and living costs
Academic qualifications and transcripts
Tuberculosis test results, if required for your country
step_by_step_guideline: Get your Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from your UK institution.
Complete the online Student visa application and pay the fee plus the Immigration Health Surcharge.
Provide biometric data at a visa application centre or via the ID-check app.
Receive your decision and set up your UKVI account for your eVisa.

visa_categories.label: Work Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 3-8 weeks
required_documents: Valid passport or other travel document
Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) reference number from a licensed UK employer
Proof of English language proficiency (approved test or qualification)
Proof of sufficient personal savings (bank statements, if required)
Tuberculosis (TB) test results, if applying from a listed country
step_by_step_guideline: Obtain a Certificate of Sponsorship from a UK Home Office-licensed employer.
Complete the online visa application form on the UK government website.
Pay the visa application fee and the Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS).
Attend a biometric appointment at a visa application centre and await the decision.

visa_categories.label: PR / Citizenship
visa_categories.visa_type: Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) & British Citizenship
visa_categories.processing_time: Typically after 5 years' residence; ILR decision within 6 months
required_documents: Proof of continuous residence for the qualifying period on your visa route
Pass certificate for the Life in the UK Test
English language qualification (B1 or above)
Criminal record / good character evidence
Current visa/BRP or eVisa share code
step_by_step_guideline: Confirm your visa route's qualifying residence period (rules are under active reform in 2026).
Pass the Life in the UK Test and meet the English language requirement.
Apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) online through the UKVI account.
Once ILR is granted, apply separately for British citizenship (naturalisation) if desired.

visa_categories.label: Tourist Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: Varies widely by embassy — often several weeks
required_documents: Valid passport (6+ months beyond planned stay recommended)
Form DS-160 confirmation page
Visa photo meeting US requirements
Evidence of ties to your home country (job, family, property)
Proof of sufficient funds for the trip
step_by_step_guideline: Complete Form DS-160 online and print the confirmation page.
Pay the visa application (MRV) fee.
Schedule and attend your interview at a US embassy or consulate.
Provide biometrics at the interview and await the visa decision.

visa_categories.label: Student Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: Varies by embassy, plus SEVIS processing
required_documents: Form I-20 from a SEVP-certified school
SEVIS I-901 fee payment receipt
Form DS-160 confirmation page
Proof of financial support for tuition and living costs
Academic transcripts and standardized test scores
step_by_step_guideline: Get accepted and receive Form I-20 from a SEVP-certified US school.
Pay the SEVIS I-901 fee and complete Form DS-160.
Schedule and attend your F-1 visa interview at a US embassy or consulate.
Provide biometrics and await your visa decision before travel.

visa_categories.label: Work Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 2-6 months (standard); 15 calendar days with premium processing
required_documents: Valid passport (recommended validity of at least 6 months)
Form DS-160 confirmation page
Approved Form I-797 (Notice of Action) from USCIS
Employer's Labor Condition Application (LCA) certified by the Department of Labor
Educational credentials and resume demonstrating specialty occupation qualification
step_by_step_guideline: Employer files a Labor Condition Application (LCA) and then Form I-129 petition with USCIS.
Complete Form DS-160 online and schedule a visa interview at a US embassy or consulate.
Attend the visa interview and provide biometric data along with supporting documents.
Await administrative processing and passport return with the visa stamp, if approved.

visa_categories.label: PR / Citizenship
visa_categories.processing_time: Green Card: several months to years; naturalization eligible after 5 years (3 if married to a citizen)
required_documents: Approved immigrant petition (Form I-130 family or I-140 employment)
Form I-485 (Adjustment of Status) or consular processing documents
Medical examination report (Form I-693)
Proof of continuous residence and physical presence
Form N-400 naturalization application (once eligible)
step_by_step_guideline: Have an eligible family member or employer file an immigrant petition (I-130 or I-140) on your behalf.
File for adjustment of status (I-485) or complete consular processing to receive your Green Card.
Maintain continuous residence for the required period (usually 5 years, or 3 if married to a US citizen).
File Form N-400, attend your biometrics/interview, pass the civics test, and take the Oath of Allegiance.

visa_categories.label: Tourist eVisa
visa_categories.processing_time: Minutes to a few hours (standard online approval)
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity from application date)
Recent digital passport-style photo
Confirmed return or onward flight booking
Proof of accommodation (hotel booking or host address)
Valid debit/credit card for the online eVisa fee
step_by_step_guideline: Confirm your nationality is on the eVisa eligibility list on the official tourist eVisa portal.
Create an account and complete the online application with passport and travel details.
Upload your photo and pay the eVisa fee securely by card.
Receive the eVisa by email — it is a multiple-entry visa valid for one year, up to 90 days per visit.

visa_categories.label: Student Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 3-6 weeks (varies by university and consulate workload)
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity)
Official admission/acceptance letter from a Saudi university or institute
Educational certificates and transcripts, attested by relevant authorities
Medical fitness certificate and required vaccination records
Passport-sized photographs meeting Saudi visa specifications
step_by_step_guideline: Secure admission at a Saudi university, which issues a sponsorship letter for your student visa.
The university submits your visa block/authorization through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs system.
Submit your passport and attested documents at the Saudi embassy or consulate for visa stamping.
Enter Saudi Arabia and complete Iqama (residence permit) registration through your university.

visa_categories.label: Work Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 10-15 business days
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity)
Signed employment contract attested by the Ministry of Labor
Educational certificates attested by the Saudi embassy and Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Medical fitness certificate from an approved medical center
Passport-sized photographs meeting Saudi visa specifications
step_by_step_guideline: Sponsoring employer obtains a work permit block visa from the Ministry of Human Resources.
Submit passport, attested documents, and medical certificate to the Saudi embassy for visa stamping.
Enter Saudi Arabia and complete the biometric enrollment for the Iqama (residence permit).
Receive the issued Iqama and finalize employer registration with GOSI and other authorities.

visa_categories.label: Umrah Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 1-5 business days
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity)
Recent digital passport-style photo
Proof of Umrah package/accommodation booking in Makkah and Madinah
Return or onward flight booking
Health/vaccination documentation required for the current season (e.g. meningitis)
step_by_step_guideline: Register on the official Nusuk Umrah platform as an international pilgrim.
Choose an integrated Umrah package or book visa, accommodation, and transport individually.
Submit passport details and pay the Umrah visa fee online through Nusuk.
Receive your Umrah visa and use the Nusuk app in-country to manage permits and Rawdah time slots.

visa_categories.label: PR / Citizenship
visa_categories.processing_time: Several weeks to months, depending on category
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity)
Proof of financial eligibility (investment, property, or income requirement)
Clean criminal record certificate
Medical fitness certificate
Completed Premium Residency application form
step_by_step_guideline: Check eligibility for the Premium Residency (permanent) or renewable annual category.
Gather financial, medical, and background-check documentation.
Submit your application through the Premium Residency program under the Ministry of Interior.
Attend any required interview and receive your Premium Residency card upon approval.

visa_categories.label: Tourist e-Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: Minutes (instant online approval for most nationalities)
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity)
Return or onward flight ticket
Proof of accommodation in Turkey
Proof of sufficient funds for the stay
Valid debit/credit card for the online e-Visa fee
step_by_step_guideline: Check your nationality's eligibility on the official e-Visa portal.
Complete the short online application with passport and travel details.
Pay the e-Visa fee securely online.
Receive your e-Visa by email and present it with your passport on arrival.

visa_categories.label: Student Residence Permit
visa_categories.processing_time: 2-4 weeks after arrival
required_documents: University acceptance/enrollment letter
Valid passport
Proof of health insurance valid in Turkey
Proof of accommodation
Passport-sized photographs
step_by_step_guideline: Get accepted by a Turkish university and receive your enrollment letter.
Apply for a student visa at a Turkish consulate, if required for your nationality.
After arrival, apply online (e-ikamet) for your student residence permit.
Submit biometrics and documents at the local migration office to collect your permit card.

visa_categories.label: Work Visa
visa_categories.processing_time: 4-8 weeks
required_documents: Valid passport (minimum 6 months validity)
Signed employment contract or job offer letter from Turkish employer
Notarized and translated educational diplomas or professional certificates
Passport-sized biometric photographs (2)
Proof of accommodation in Turkey during the work assignment
step_by_step_guideline: Employer submits the work permit application through the Turkish Ministry of Labor's online system.
Applicant submits the corresponding visa application at the Turkish consulate in their home country.
Attend the consulate interview and biometric appointment, if required.
Collect the approved work visa and register for the residence permit upon arrival in Turkey.

visa_categories.label: PR / Citizenship
visa_categories.processing_time: Several months, after residency or investment criteria are met
required_documents: Proof of continuous legal residence (typically 8 years) or qualifying investment (e.g. real estate purchase)
Valid passport and existing residence permit history
Proof of financial stability and health insurance
Clean criminal record certificate
Completed long-term residence or citizenship application form
step_by_step_guideline: Confirm your route: standard long-term residence (8 years) or the investment-based citizenship program.
Gather residence history, financial, and clean-record documentation.
Apply at the Provincial Directorate of Migration Management (residence) or Ministry of Interior (citizenship).
Attend biometrics/interview and receive your long-term permit or citizenship decision.
